propositions: test_perf asserts a fixed 50ms wall-clock budget on a single execution of rebar.llm.overlap.retrieve() over 300 digests, causing flaky failures under CI runner contention despite the function being fast (~1.6ms median locally)
Single-sample wall-clock measurement is not robust to transient CPU scheduling contention on shared runners, inflating observed time ~180x above true cost and failing the gate for unrelated changes
The fix measures the minimum elapsed time across N>=5 runs and asserts min < budget, reflecting uncontended compute cost while retaining sensitivity to real algorithmic regressions
Best-of-N approach allows transient stalls on individual samples without failing the gate while still catching sustained/uniform slowdowns
